answer.rationale: Deploy onboarding and signup simplification broadly to improve sustainable activation, time-to-value, and retention across self-serve SMB accounts. The confirmed onboarding result showed higher completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and 3% better 30-day retention; prior signup simplification also produced a durable activation lift. Avoid responding with broad promotional pricing: the recovered discount test increased signups and qualified revenue short term but reduced 30-day retention by 12% and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. This does not directly eliminate competitor price pressure, so monitor price-sensitive churn and segment outcomes while rolling out.
